notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
